items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer (versions prior to 1.11.12) allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie. This PHP object injection flaw has a CVSS score of 9.8 and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.3) in Amasty Order Attributes (versions up to 3.16.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to a Magento store. Successful exploitation can lead to remote code execution, malware hosting, and stored XSS.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Part of APSB26-92, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. Indications suggest active exploitation attempts in the wild.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image. A fix was released in Magento 2.4.9, but older supported versions remain vulnerable without backports.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin resolves multiple critical and important vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. It addresses issues that could lead to unauthenticated customer account takeover.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Included in APSB26-92, this high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) is a stored XSS flaw that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-92, this high-severity stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires both authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 7.6), part of APSB26-92, affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) resolved in APSB26-92, which could enable a security-feature bypass. This flaw requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.
